parameter.name: email
parameter.label: Email Address
parameter.description: Email address of the X-Sense account.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Interval in seconds for polling the device inventory from the X-Sense cloud. If not set, the default from the binding configuration applies.

parameter.name: houseId
parameter.label: House ID
parameter.description: Identifier of the home in the X-Sense cloud.

parameter.name: stationSn
parameter.label: Serial Number
parameter.description: Serial number of the base station.
